tasks.check: deno check src/ && deno lint && deno fmt --check
tasks.web-app:build: deno bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --output=dist/web-app/app.js src/web-app/app.ts && cp src/web-app/app.html dist/web-app/app.html
tasks.chrome-extension:build: deno bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outdir=dist/chrome-extension src/chrome-extension/background.ts src/chrome-extension/bridge.ts src/chrome-extension/page.ts src/chrome-extension/popup.ts && cp src/chrome-extension/manifest.json src/chrome-extension/popup.html dist/chrome-extension/
